intro.h2: Cabinets designed with you and built with care
paragraphs: WOODEYE LLC builds custom kitchen cabinets in Stayton, OR, and the way we work starts at the screen. We sit down with you, plan the cabinets on a computer program and change the design as your ideas come in, before a single board is cut.

What customers write about most is the craftsmanship. One couple asked for oak on the outside and found that even the hidden parts were beautiful, with quiet-closing doors and drawers throughout. They also found the cost was lower than pre-made cabinets from a big company. Another customer called her custom vanity absolutely breathtaking and said it far exceeded her expectations.

services.h2: Custom kitchen cabinets in Stayton and more

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Replace old cabinets with a set designed for your kitchen. We plan the layout with you on a computer program, build the boxes, doors and drawers, and fit soft-close hardware so every door and drawer shuts quietly.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen cabinets with dark stone countertop, full-height backsplash and stainless dishwasher under a window

items.name: Custom bathroom vanities
items.blurb: A vanity is small, but it is the piece you see every morning. We help you choose the wood and the color for your space, then build it with attention to the smallest details, like one customer's walnut-tone vanity.

image.alt: Rich walnut-tone custom vanity with wide drawers and dark pulls on a black marble-look tile floor

items.name: Whole-house cabinet replacement
items.blurb: After a crawlspace water leak, one family's contractor brought us in to renovate every cabinet in the house. We work with your contractor or directly with you, using quality materials when you need a lot of cabinetry replaced at once.

image.alt: Light oak cabinets with drawers and doors with brushed metal pulls before countertop installation

items.name: Custom inserts and storage
items.blurb: Corner cabinets, pull-outs and special storage are where custom work pays off. One customer asked for a lazy Susan, and we built it for their corner cabinet. Bring us the storage problem and we will design around it.

image.alt: Custom wooden lazy Susan inside a dark grey corner cabinet holding pots and bowls

about.h2: Meet Barak, the craftsman behind WOODEYE
about.text: WOODEYE LLC is a cabinet maker at 278 E High St in Stayton, Oregon. In our Google reviews customers talk to and about one person: Barak. He plans the job with you, builds it and answers your reviews himself. Customers describe him as responsive, careful with details and good at listening, with one review summary saying he gave a family their dream kitchen. Some clients come to us directly; others are sent by their contractor, like the family who needed every cabinet in the house redone after a water leak. All 18 reviews on Google average a perfect 5.0.
about.owner_role: Cabinet maker and designer named in every review; replies to reviews as the owner

steps.title: Talk about your space
steps.text: Call (458) 356-8185 or stop by on E High St. Tell us about the room, what bothers you about the old cabinets and the wood you like.

steps.title: Plan on the computer
steps.text: We design your cabinets together on a computer program, adjusting the layout, storage and details until it matches what you want.

steps.title: Pick wood and color
steps.text: We help you choose the wood species and color for your space, like the oak exteriors or walnut tones our customers chose.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Each cabinet is built with quality materials and the details you asked for, including soft-close doors and drawers and any custom inserts.

steps.title: Check and hand over
steps.text: We go over the finished cabinets with you, doors and drawers included, so they are ready for countertops, like the oak kitchen in our gallery.

items.name: Barbara S.
items.text: The experience working with Barak at Woodeye to get new kitchen cabinets to replace our very old ones was great from start to finish. We had a very good time working with him to plan the cabinets on a computer program he had. Barak was very responsive to our ideas. When we saw the cabinets we were blown away!! They were so beautiful. We had asked for oak on the outside, which is beautiful. But even the parts that don't show are beautiful. All the doors and drawers have that quiet closure mechanism, which seems so luxurious. And yet the cost of the cabinets from Woodeye was less than pre-made cabinets from some big company. We highly recommend Woodeye and Barak. The pictures we uploaded are before countertop installation.

items.name: Natasha
items.text: We had a custom vanity made and it turned out absolutely breathtaking. From start to finish, the experience was wonderful. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was just right, especially when it came to choosing the perfect wood color for our space. His communication was excellent, and it was clear that he paid close attention to even the smallest details. The craftsmanship is stunning and far exceeded our expectations. We could not be happier and would highly recommend his work to anyone looking for a great product from a great craftsman.

items.name: Dan B.
items.text:
Our introduction to Barak was through our contractor that had done a complete renovation of all our cabinets in the house, from a water leak in our crawlspace.

Barak’s professionalism and craftsmanship were a welcomed addition when our world had been turned upside down.

We are so happy with the quality of materials he uses, and his design sense shines on us every day. He even made a custom lazy Susan for us (attached photo).

I don’t hesitate to recommend him for any cabinetry/woodworking job, you will be pleased with the results.

service_area.h2: Custom cabinets from our Stayton shop
service_area.text: WOODEYE LLC is at 278 E High St in Stayton, OR. We build kitchen cabinets, vanities and custom storage for homeowners and work alongside contractors on larger renovations. If you live outside Stayton and want to know whether we can take on your kitchen, call (458) 356-8185 and tell us where the project is and what you have in mind.

items.q: Do I get to see the design before you build?
items.a: Yes. We plan your cabinets with you on a computer program, so you can see the layout and talk through changes before any wood is cut. Customers say we were very responsive to their ideas while planning, and that seeing the finished cabinets still blew them away.

items.q: Are custom cabinets more expensive than store-bought?
items.a: Not always. One customer wrote that our custom oak kitchen cabinets cost less than pre-made cabinets from some big company. The price depends on your layout, wood and details, so call and ask us to price your project and compare it with the quotes you already have.

Yes. We build custom vanities and help you choose the right wood color for the room. One customer called her finished vanity absolutely breathtaking and said the craftsmanship far exceeded her expectations. Bring a photo or measurements of your bathroom and we can start from there.

items.q: Can you work with my contractor?
items.a: Yes. One family met us through their contractor after a crawlspace water leak meant every cabinet in the house had to be renovated. We are happy to work alongside your builder or remodeler, or with you directly if you are managing the project yourself.

Monday to Friday 8 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 5 PM and Sunday 10 AM to 7 PM. Evening and weekend hours make it easier to come in and plan when you are not at work. You can also call (458) 356-8185 first.

final_cta.text: Call Barak at WOODEYE and start designing your kitchen or vanity.
